name: Quite Apps
metaTitle: Quite Apps: free Chrome extensions that remove ads and clutter
metaDescription: Free, open-source Chrome extensions from an independent UK studio. Remove YouTube ads, clear your Facebook feed, and see what sites store on you.
leadIn: We are a small independent studio in the UK. We make Chrome extensions that take things away rather than add them. We publish the source too, so you never have to take our word for what they do.
heroLead: Three free Chrome extensions that strip the advertising out of YouTube, clear the clutter from Facebook, and show you what sites have stored on your machine before you delete it. No account, no tracking, and you can read every line of the code.
install: Click Load unpacked and select the folder you unzipped.
installNote: Chrome shows a "Developer mode extensions" warning each time it starts. That is normal for anything installed outside the Web Store, and it can be dismissed.

principles.title: One job, done properly
principles.body: Every extension has a single purpose. If a feature does not serve that purpose it does not ship, however much we would enjoy building it.

principles.title: The fewest permissions we can ask for
principles.body: Two of them ask for a single permission and access to the one site they are for. The third starts with no access to any site at all, and asks for one domain at a time, at the moment you press the button.

principles.title: Read the code yourself
principles.body: Everything we ship is MIT licensed, with the source public on GitHub. Nothing is sent anywhere. There is no server and no analytics. You do not have to trust us on that, because you can check it yourself.

contactBody: Bug reports, feature requests, or a note to say something broke after a site update. All welcome, and all read by the person who wrote the code. Issues on GitHub work just as well.
donateBody: All three extensions are free, MIT licensed and always will be. There is no paid tier waiting behind them. If one has saved you some irritation and you feel like putting something in the hat, it keeps the work going. If not, that is genuinely fine.
installFirstRelease: Download the latest release and unzip it. You need the folder. Keep it somewhere permanent, because moving or deleting it stops the extension working.
installFirstZip: On GitHub, click the green Code button, choose Download ZIP, and unzip it. You need the folder. Keep it somewhere permanent, because moving or deleting it stops the extension working.
